title: Welcome to Mappi
readOnly: Your read-only role can't set up the workspace. Ask an administrator, or explore on your own.

goal.title: What do you want to achieve with Mappi?
goal.subtitle: We'll recommend a template for it. You can change everything later.
goal.label: Your goal

diagnose.title: Diagnose
diagnose.body: Measure a situation and deliver a level, recommendations, and a plan.

qualify.title: Qualify or recommend
qualify.body: Direct each person to the right service or next step.

capture.title: Capture processes
capture.body: Understand how a team works through text, audio, and follow-ups.

collect.title: Collect information
collect.body: Create a structured survey without mandatory scoring.

workspace.title: Set up your workspace
workspace.subtitle: Tell us about your organization.
workspace.name: Workspace name
workspace.languageHint: Your questionnaires, results and emails use this language.
workspace.websiteInvalid: Enter a valid website, like acme.com.

template.title: Start from a template
template.subtitle: Recommended for your goal. You'll adjust it in the next step.

builder.title: Make it yours
builder.subtitle: Complete the checklist to save your questionnaire.

items.title: Confirm your questionnaire title
items.question: Edit a question to fit your context
items.ending: Review what the person will receive at the end

builder.editHint: Edit the first four questions here; the rest can be edited later in the editor.

ending.title: What the person receives at the end
ending.diagnostic: A result with their level, a recommendation and an action plan:
ending.processMapping: A thank-you screen, while their answers are mapped into a process:

confirm.title: Create the questionnaire?
confirm.body_one: We'll save "{{title}}" with {{count}} question to your account. You can edit it later.
confirm.body_other: We'll save "{{title}}" with {{count}} questions to your account. You can edit it later.

publish.title: Publish it
publish.subtitle: Choose the link people will open to answer.
publish.slugInvalid: Use only lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens (at most 100 characters).

test.title: Try it as a respondent
test.subtitle: We opened your questionnaire in a new tab. Answer it once to see what your respondents get.

result.title: You're all set!
result.subtitle: Your questionnaire is live. Share it and watch the answers come in.
result.finishFailed: We couldn't finish your setup. Please try again.

aiMaturity.title: AI Maturity Diagnostic
aiMaturity.description: Find out how ready your organization is to adopt artificial intelligence.

strategyPlan.title: Does your organization have a defined AI strategy?

strategyGoals.title: Are your AI initiatives tied to business goals and a budget?

dataAccess.title: Is your data organized and easy to access?

dataQuality.title: Do you have data quality and governance practices?

processes.title: Have you identified processes that AI could automate or improve?

talent.title: Does your team have the skills to work with AI?

culture.title: Is your organization open to experimenting with AI?

technology.title: Do you have the tools and infrastructure to deploy AI solutions?

initial.name: Initial
initial.description: AI is still an idea: there is no strategy, data or team behind it yet.
initial.recommendation: Start with one internal use case with clear value and little risk.
initial.action: Pick a pilot this month and name the person in charge.

developing.name: Developing
developing.description: There are AI initiatives, but they are isolated and hard to scale.
developing.recommendation: Connect your initiatives to business goals and measure their impact.
developing.action: Define three metrics and review them every month.

advanced.name: Advanced
advanced.description: AI is part of how your organization works and makes decisions.
advanced.recommendation: Scale what works and share your practices across teams.
advanced.action: Document your playbook and train the next teams.

serviceQualification.title: Service Qualification
serviceQualification.description: Tell us about your needs and we'll suggest the right next step.

need.title: What do you need help with?

timeline.title: When do you want to start?

budget.title: What budget do you have in mind?

challenge.title: What is the main challenge you want to solve?

role.title: What is your role in the decision?

ending.title: Thank you!
ending.message: We'll review your answers and contact you with the right next step.

processDiscovery.title: Process Discovery
processDiscovery.description: Help us understand how your team works, step by step.

process.title: Which process do you want to describe?
process.criterion: Names a specific process and what it is for.

steps.title: Walk us through the steps of the process, from start to finish.
steps.criterion: Describes the steps in order, with a start and an end.

people.title: Who takes part in each step?

tools.title: Which tools or systems do you use?

bottlenecks.title: Where does the process get stuck or take the longest?
bottlenecks.criterion: Points to a specific step and explains why it is slow.

frequency.title: How often does the process run?

improvement.title: If you could change one thing about the process, what would it be?

ending.title: Thank you!
ending.message: Thanks for sharing how your process works.

customerDiscovery.title: Customer Discovery
customerDiscovery.description: Help us understand what you value and how we can do better.

source.title: How did you hear about us?

recommend.title: How likely are you to recommend us to a friend?

value.title: What do you value most about us?

usage.title: How often do you use our products or services?

other.title: Is there anything else you'd like to tell us?
